title: The first conversation live with Claude on 45 new people, and the 'I don't know' bug it found
request: The owner: '$15 to test and make fixes for this plan' (plan 2026-10-25 Part B3).
spec: 45 dev people of the new homework (three a kind), each played on the rules and with Claude as the Home agent and the roles, every live play kept whole; the failures read, the top ones fixed, the same people played again.
plan: A trial of two people to price a person.
Read every failure to its cause.
Fix what is a product bug; name what is a missing ability.

decisions.decision: A person written with answers left out says "I don't know" to what they cannot answer (journeys flag dont_know).
decisions.why: A silent person stopped every play at the first unanswerable question: the test measured the stop, not DCLab; the older journeys keep their silence so their results stay comparable.

decisions.decision: An answer that is only "I don't know" is never recorded; the question closes as declined; only the moment is assumed, said as inferred.
decisions.why: Every solution needs a moment; an assumption the person can see and change is honest, a stated 'I don't know.' is not a moment.

decisions.decision: The Solution page's missing kind proposal is a package of its own, not a quick fix.
decisions.why: Each kind needs its own fields (a forecast's series and horizon, a ranking's user and item, a segmentation's outcome): proposing them needs a design per kind.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py (not_known, NOT_KNOWN, ASSUMED_MOMENT, _not_known in record and note), dclab_rnd/draft/card.py (an assumed moment is inferred), dclab_rnd/draft/api.py (project.assumed.prediction_moment), dclab_rnd/agent_eval/journeys/__init__.py (_Person dont_know, FIELDS, _find/_unsure), dclab_rnd/understand_students.py (the new and the sealed people played saying I don't know), tests/test_home_not_known.py and tests/test_journeys_dont_know.py (new); HRN-045 (17 of 17). dclab_rnd/studio/engine.py (prepare: no feature left is refused clearly), tests/test_engine_real_tables.py. dclab_rnd/studio/solution.py (_whole_numbers: a whole-number entity id is a group candidate), tests/test_solution_entity.py; HRN-046.

findings.defect: DCLab recorded "I don't know." as the person's answer.
findings.scenario: Of 589 written people: 46 prediction moments, 33 outcomes, 31 families and 39 budgets were "I don't know."; 4 projects were built with it as their moment.
findings.cause: The Home agent's record and note stored any reply; the core's NOT_SAID was never read there.
findings.fix: A reply that is only not-knowing is never a value: the question closes as declined, the field stays unknown, the moment is assumed and said so.

findings.defect: The understood family does not reach the kind that is built.
findings.scenario: JH-forecasting-005 and -008: Claude's card said forecasting, the build ran regression; embedded people ran as text_tabular; 30 of 45 people were wrong in both arms, mostly kinds whose Solution page needs fields the person typed in the older journeys.
findings.cause: kinds.resolve reads a declared kind, the pack, then the task; the card's family is not read, and no kind proposes its own fields.
findings.fix: Next package: the Solution page proposes the kind and its fields from the card's family and the table.

findings.defect: The entity is not found without being named.
findings.scenario: JH-rare_event-000..002: the folds were not grouped by biker when the person did not name the biker, though biker_id repeats.
findings.cause: biker_id (whole numbers, read as floats where a cell is empty) was left out of the group candidates for being numeric; its phone came in its place. With the candidate, the groups modifier still does not group: the bikers recur over time, so a forward split keeps the future out, and it groups only if the model will face new bikers, which the person must say.
findings.fix: A numeric id-named column of whole numbers that repeats is a group candidate (studio/solution.py _whole_numbers). Left for the owner: when the person does not know, ask with the evidence or group by default.

findings.defect: The engine crashed on a table with no usable feature.
findings.cause: A ranking log (user_id, item_id, time, event) ran as binary: the ids identifiers, the time the time column, the event the outcome: no feature left, and nothing checked before fitting.
findings.fix: studio/engine.py prepare refuses a table with no feature left, naming the columns and the likely kind (a ranking), before any recipe is registered.

findings.defect: The written person answered a question with another field's words.
findings.scenario: Asked when the prediction is made, it answered 'churned' (its outcome); the Solution then refused the moment as too short.
findings.cause: The regex fallback for untagged questions also ran for tagged fields the person lacks.
findings.fix: A person who does not know a tagged field says so (dont_know people only).

measurements.name: the live run
measurements.gate: 45 dev people, both arms, capped at EUR 4
measurements.result: the rules right on 11, Claude as the Home agent right on 14 of 45 (4 only Claude, 1 only the rules, 30 neither); EUR 3.6294; the data investigator asked 36 times

measurements.name: after the fix
measurements.gate: the affected tests and the harness suite
measurements.result: 379 tests in 18 files pass; HRN-045 17 of 17

outcome: A real product bug fixed (I don't know recorded as an answer); the largest missing ability named (the kind and its fields from the understood family).
lessons: A test person who never says 'I don't know' hides how the product treats one who does.
Read every failure to its cause before counting it: most were one gap, not thirty.
risks: The fixed product changes the plays: the homework is played again before the students are trained for their exam.
